extracted.name: Potato nuggets
instruction_lines: Mashed potatoes, grate paneer, chop spinach.
Add cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, salt, green chilli paste. Mix well make dough.
Make balls, prepare a slurry of all-purpose flour, bread crumbs. Put balls in slurry and roll in bread crumbs and fry in appe pan.
